full_page.content:
1924, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 3
Jan. 9 James McNalley - drinking - lost employment - wayword and care- less - enrolled to-day
Jan 12 Michael R. Newman 70 Careless about religion, drinking, etc
13th Baby James Math. Callahan - 17 months reported water on brain and finally derangements of head-bones and spine - entered to- day
Jan. 14th Jennie E. McCabe (668 Lexington Ave) promised year ago to put Poor Souls in etc if serious heart failure improved - Dr. Sur- prised that she lived. Today in evident health gave 5 perpet- ual memberships for poor Souls - in Hon. Sacred Heart, B.V. Mary, St. Joseph, St. Ann and St. Anthony
16th Joseph P. Wall - asmetic - drinking - has nothing. has forgotten not only Latin prayers but even the Lord's prayer in his mother tong. Joined one year. Hardiman
16 H. Post - no religion whatever - father of 11 children - goes out in moonlight and thanks God.
14 Mrs Mary Hardiman - husband motor-man on subway - fell 8 yrs ago, bumping her forehead severely and losing her memory completely. Saturday - evenings has to have a note on table for Sunday morn- ing: "This is Sunday." - to remind her to go to holy Mass. Re- port Jan. 16th - "My wife's memory is evidently improving. Thanks be to God!
18th Patrick J. Cavanagh 177-E. 108 St., City Enrolled against drink one yr. -- Febr. 28 reported "Doing Fine --- =
J. J. Hynes - printer - $50. per week, drinking not working since Sept. 1923 -- bad company
Febr 25 747 - 3rd Ave. Working and doing fine since shortly after enroll- ment
29
Page 4 Jan. 20 Helen G. Quigley (King's Park Hospital) 3 months there - over one yr. ???
